# Brain dump — sample projects and intentions (multi-page)

This sample document collects the current state of a fictional, intentionally
generic set of community and home projects. Everything is still fairly flat
and unstructured.

## Community Garden Planner

Build a small planning tool for a neighbourhood community garden: plots,
volunteer shifts, a planting calendar and shared tools. The goal is a usable
first version.

- define the plot and volunteer data model
- connect the calendar import
- build the planning board
- rank the open tasks
- document the README

## Fictional Consulting Portfolio

Assemble a demonstrably fictional consulting portfolio: sample case studies,
service descriptions and a reusable proposal template. There is a writing part
and a packaging part.

- collect the sample case studies
- review the service descriptions
- organise the proposal template
- check the publishing checklist

## Language-Learning App

Create a small language-learning app for personal study. It should support
lessons, vocabulary review and simple progress tracking.

- design the lesson screen
- build the vocabulary review flow
- add progress tracking
- test on a sample device

## Public Conference Preparation

Prepare a talk for a public community conference: abstract, slides, a live
demo and a rehearsal. Keep the material reusable for future events.

- write the talk abstract
- outline the session
- prepare the live demo
- improve the speaker notes

## Home Lab Backup

Set up a reliable backup routine for a small home lab: local snapshots,
off-site copies and a documented restore test.

- configure the snapshot schedule
- configure the off-site copy
- document the restore procedure
- verify the first restore

## Sample Training Application

Apply for a sample training programme: gather certificates, shortlist a course
and submit the application form.

- gather the sample certificates
- shortlist the course options
- submit the application form

## Generic Administrative Renewal

Renew a generic administrative document: collect the forms, book an
appointment and confirm the renewal.

- collect the renewal forms
- book an appointment
- confirm the renewal

## Fictional Budget Planning

Plan a fictional monthly budget: categories, monthly limits and scheduled
transfers.

- list the budget categories
- set the monthly limits
- schedule the transfers

## Sample Equipment Maintenance

Maintain a set of sample lab devices: inventory, firmware updates and a
maintenance log.

- inventory the devices
- update the firmware
- record the maintenance log

## Open-Source Documentation Library

Build a small documentation library for open-source notes with a search page.

- choose the documentation tooling
- index the sample documents
- connect the search page

## Sample Certification Portfolio

Keep track of sample certifications and update a public profile.

- list completed certifications
- update the public profile
- highlight them in the portfolio

## Open questions, resources and waiting items

These are still open, waiting or blocked and need a decision or an external
reply.

- QUESTION: which hosting option should the garden planner use?
- RESOURCE: a shared seed inventory spreadsheet
- WAITING: reply from the community hall about the event date
- BLOCKER: the demo laptop needs a replacement battery
- decision needed on the backup retention window

## Someday / ideas

- learn to play the ukulele (someday)
- repaint the garden shed (someday)
- vague idea for a plant-swap mobile app (idea)
